description: Canonical, configurable pattern list for detecting private Claude session data before it reaches a public surface (GitHub, Slack, commit messages). Loaded by io.flowtree.PrivateLinkDetector (Java) and tools/mcp/manager/private_link_detector.py (Python). Both engines use the same regexes, which are written in the common subset of java.util.regex and Python re. A pattern with "collapse": true is also matched against a whitespace-stripped variant of the text, so a link broken across lines is still caught; a pattern without it (the default) is matched only against the normalised text, so joining whitespace cannot fabricate a match from ordinary prose. Edit this file to change what is blocked; keep the Python embedded fallback in sync (asserted by test_private_link_detector.py).

patterns.name: claude_ai_session_or_app_url
patterns.description: A claude.ai application URL: code session, chat, artifact, share, project, or recents. Matches http, https, www and bare host forms because the host+path fragment is enough. Scanned against the whitespace-collapsed variant too, because whitespace never belongs inside a URL.

patterns.name: claude_code_session_path
patterns.description: A Claude Code session permalink. Scanned against the whitespace-collapsed variant too, because whitespace never belongs inside a URL.

patterns.name: bare_session_id
patterns.description: A bare Claude session identifier with no surrounding URL. Not collapse-scanned: joining a trailing 'session_' to the next prose word would fabricate a match.

patterns.name: claude_attribution_credit
patterns.description: An attribution line crediting Claude/Anthropic as co-author or generator of the work.

patterns.name: claude_noreply_identity
patterns.description: A Claude/Anthropic identity e-mail address used in attribution trailers. Only the domain is matched: an unanchored local-part prefix made every position of a long run of address characters a fresh attempt, so a large file took quadratic time to scan.

block_message:
BLOCKED: this write was refused because it contains a private Claude session link or identifier.

Including it is actively harmful. It leaks the owner's private session data into a public repository, exposing the owner's privacy and security. Once published the link persists in the repository's edit history, in GitHub notification e-mails, and in every fork and mirror of the repository, and it cannot be fully retracted even if the visible copy is later deleted.

You have been instructed, explicitly and repeatedly, never to do this. Doing it again is being treated as malice, not as a mistake. This attempt is being recorded as an incident and reported to the owner, and there will be consequences.

Stop now. Examine why you were about to include this link. Remove it entirely. Do not look for another field, another encoding, or another route to carry it. Resubmit only once the content contains no Claude session link, no session id, and no attribution line.
